Package index

The two main functions

Start here. tab() builds a colour-coded cross-table; tab_reg() a regression table that looks and behaves like one.

tab()
Cross-table with color helpers
tab_reg()
Regression table (effect measures) as a tabxplor table

Variants of tab()

The same idea as tab(), for a particular input.

tab_num()
Means table
tab_counts()
Cross-table from already-aggregated counts ("from the middle")

Regression shortcuts and plots

tab_logit() and multi_logit() are thin wrappers around tab_reg() for logistic models. or_plot() and lm_plots() draw plots from a finished regression table.

tab_logit()
Logistic-regression table (odds ratios)
multi_logit()
Compare several logistic-regression models (odds ratios side by side)
or_plot() experimental
Odds-ratio forest plot of a tabxplor regression table
lm_plots() experimental
Diagnostic plots for a linear / generalized-linear model

Export a finished table

tab_export() is the one function most users need. tab_html(), tab_md(), tab_xl() and tab_plot() are the per-format exporters it wraps (tab_kable() is an alias of tab_html()); tab_css() / tab_md_css() emit the colour stylesheet for a whole document.

tab_export()
Export a tabxplor table to Excel, HTML, Markdown, or a plot
tab_html() tab_kable()
Print a tabxplor table in html
tab_md()
Export a tabxplor table to a markdown table
tab_xl()
Excel output for tabxplor tables, with formatting and colors
tab_plot() superseded
Print a tabxplor table as plot
tab_css()
Generate the tabxplor stylesheet
tab_md_css()
CSS for the colour spans of tab_md

Captions, options and data

Colour scales and palettes are customised with set_color_breaks(), set_color_palette() and set_color_style() (documented on the tab_many() page).

set_caption() get_caption()
Store a caption on a tabxplor table
tabxplor-options tabxplor.options
tabxplor global options
gss_cat_data_formatting()
forcats::gss_cat test dataframe, from US General Social Survey, but formatted with merged levels for cleaner tables, and first levels chosen to be used as references (for color helpers, regressions, etc.)

Point-and-click interface (jamovi)

jmvtab()
Crosstables
jmvtabreg()
Regressions

The engine, reshaping and combining

tab_many() is the vectorised engine behind tab() (and the home of the colour helpers set_color_breaks() / set_color_palette() / set_color_style()). The rest reshape and combine finished tables.

tab_many() tab_get_vars() is_tab() set_color_palette() set_color_style() get_color_style() set_color_breaks() get_color_breaks() superseded
Many cross-tables as one, with color helpers
tab_spread()
Spread a tab, passing a tab variable to column
tab_compact()
Bind a list of tabs with the same col_vars (and no tab_vars) into a single tab
tab_transpose() deprecated
Transpose a cross-table (swap its rows and columns)
complete_partial_totals()
Complete partial total rows

The fmt cell type

The tabxplor_fmt vctrs record behind every numeric cell, and its constructors.

fmt() is_fmt() get_num() set_num() get_type() set_type() is_totrow() as_totrow() is_tottab() as_tottab() set_display() is_totcol() as_totcol() is_refrow() as_refrow() get_comp_all() set_comp_all() get_ref_type() set_diff_type() get_ci_type() set_ci_type() get_col_var() set_col_var() get_model_family() set_model_family() is_refcol() as_refcol() get_color() get_color_bg() get_color_signif() set_color() set_color_signif() get_digits() set_digits()

The step-by-step pipeline (superseded)

The individual steps tab_many() now fuses into one. Each is still exported and usable on its own, but tab() / tab_num() supersede them.

tab_plain()
Plain single cross-table
tab_prepare()
Prepare data for tab_plain.
tab_pct() superseded
Add percentages and diffs to a tab
tab_tot() superseded
Add totals to a tab
tab_totaltab() superseded
Add total table to a tab
tab_ci()
Add confidence intervals to a tab
tab_chi2()
Add Chi2 summaries to a tab

Data-prep and text helpers

Small utilities for preparing data or laying out a table.

score_from_lv1()
Create a score variable by counting factors at their first level
fct_recode_helper()
fct_recode helper to recode multiple variables
tab_wrap_text()
Wrap column names and character/factor variables.
tab_get_wrapped_dimensions()
Get the number of actual rows and the max character length of a table after being wrapped (count \n as a linebreak).
tab_parallel_stop()
Stop the tabxplor parallel worker pool
kable_tabxplor_style() deprecated
Print a tabxplor table in html
